states.name: ArticleAbsent
states.notes: No active article exists for the target slug; this is the initial state before create and the observable state after deletion.

states.name: ArticleActiveOriginal
states.notes: A persisted active article exists with initial title, description, body, author, slug, timestamps, and optional tag associations.

states.name: ArticleActiveContentUpdated
states.notes: The owner has updated one or more persisted content fields; omitted fields are preserved by validator prefill. A title update regenerates the slug from the new title.

states.name: ArticleActiveTagsUpdated
states.notes: The active article has tag associations replaced or cleared by update payload tagList handling.

states.name: ArticleDeletedUnavailable
states.notes: The article row has been deleted through GORM Delete and is no longer returned by normal detail/list queries.

states.name: RequestRejectedNoMutation
states.notes: A protected request or validation/ownership branch rejects the request before mutating the article state.

transitions.guard: POST /api/articles reaches the authenticated route group without a valid token.
transitions.action: AuthMiddleware(true) aborts with 401 before ArticleCreate runs; no ArticleModel is saved.

transitions.guard: Authenticated create payload is missing required fields, has title shorter than min=4, or violates max sizes.
transitions.action: ArticleModelValidator.Bind returns an error; ArticleCreate responds 422 and skips SaveOne.

transitions.guard: Authenticated create payload has valid title, description, body, and omitted or empty tagList.
transitions.action: Bind creates slug, assigns author, setTags takes the zero-tag branch, SaveOne persists the article, and ArticleSerializer returns 201 response fields.

transitions.guard: Authenticated create payload has valid fields and non-empty tagList.
transitions.action: setTags fetches or creates TagModel rows, assigns article tags, SaveOne persists article/tag associations, and serializer sorts tagList.

transitions.guard: PUT /api/articles/{slug} uses a slug with no active article.
transitions.action: ArticleUpdate returns 404 from the FindOneArticle failure before ownership, binding, or update logic.

transitions.guard: PUT target exists, but authenticated requester is not the article author.
transitions.action: AuthorID is compared with GetArticleUserModel(currentUser).ID; mismatch returns 403 and the persisted article remains unchanged.

transitions.guard: PUT target exists and requester is owner, but the update payload violates validator constraints such as short title or null/invalid tagList binding.
transitions.action: NewArticleModelValidatorFillWith preloads existing fields, Bind fails, ArticleUpdate returns 422 and skips model.Update.

transitions.guard: PUT target exists, requester is owner, and payload supplies a valid partial content update while omitting tagList.
transitions.action: Validator prefill preserves omitted fields and existing tags; model.Update applies supplied content changes and serializer returns updated article.

transitions.guard: PUT target exists, requester is owner, and payload supplies a valid replacement title.
transitions.action: Bind regenerates Slug with slug.Make(new title); model.Update stores the new title/slug and later reads must use the returned current slug.

transitions.guard: PUT target exists, requester is owner, and payload explicitly contains tagList: [].
transitions.action: setTags takes the len(tags)==0 branch, assigns an empty tag slice, and model.Update clears article tag associations.

transitions.guard: PUT target exists, requester is owner, and payload contains a non-empty tagList.
transitions.action: setTags fetches existing tags, creates missing tags, replaces the article tag slice, and serializer returns the sorted replacement tagList.

transitions.guard: DELETE target exists, but authenticated requester is not the article author.
transitions.action: ArticleDelete performs ownership check after successful FindOneArticle, returns 403 on mismatch, and skips DeleteArticleModel.

transitions.guard: DELETE target exists and requester is the article author.
transitions.action: ArticleDelete passes ownership check, DeleteArticleModel calls GORM Delete by slug, and the handler returns 200 delete success.

transitions.guard: GET /api/articles/{slug} is requested for a deleted article slug.
transitions.action: FindOneArticle cannot find an active row and ArticleRetrieve returns 404 Invalid slug.

transitions.guard: GET /api/articles list or filtered list is requested after deletion.
transitions.action: FindManyArticle uses normal GORM queries/associations, so the deleted article is excluded from active list results and counts.

transitions.guard: DELETE /api/articles/{slug} uses a slug with no active article.
transitions.action: ArticleDelete skips ownership check when FindOneArticle fails, still calls DeleteArticleModel, and returns 200 if the delete operation reports no database error.

transitions.guard: PUT /api/articles/{slug} reaches the authenticated route group without a valid token.
transitions.action: AuthMiddleware(true) aborts with 401 before ArticleUpdate runs; article remains unchanged.

transitions.guard: DELETE /api/articles/{slug} reaches the authenticated route group without a valid token.
transitions.action: AuthMiddleware(true) aborts with 401 before ArticleDelete runs; article remains active.

coverage: Auth reject branch for protected create
paths.test_intent: Confirm the protected create route is blocked by middleware before validation or persistence when no token is supplied.
paths.expected_internal_effect: Context user remains zero, ArticleCreate is not executed, and no ArticleModel row is inserted.

paths.test_intent: Exercise required/min/max create validation and prove invalid data does not reach persistence.
paths.expected_internal_effect: ArticleModelValidator.Bind returns a validation error; SaveOne is not called and article count/lookup remains unchanged.

paths.test_intent: Create an article with valid required fields and omitted or empty tags.
paths.expected_internal_effect: Slug is generated from title, ArticleUserModel is associated to the current user, an ArticleModel row is saved, Tags is empty, and response includes identity/content/author metadata.

paths.test_intent: Create an article with a non-empty tagList to cover tag association creation and response sorting.
paths.expected_internal_effect: Existing tags are reused or missing tags are created, article_tags associations are saved, and serializer returns a sorted tagList.

paths.test_intent: Update only one content field as owner while omitting other fields and tagList.
paths.expected_internal_effect: Existing model is loaded with author/tags, omitted fields are prefilled, model.Update changes only supplied content, existing tags are retained, and later retrieve returns updated values.

paths.test_intent: Update the title and replace tags to cover slug regeneration plus tag replacement.
paths.expected_internal_effect: Slug changes to slug.Make(new title), Tags is replaced with the supplied tag set, and follow-up reads should use the returned current slug rather than the old slug.

paths.test_intent: Update an existing tagged article with tagList: [] and verify the internal clear-tags path.
paths.expected_internal_effect: setTags assigns an empty tag slice, model.Update clears tag associations, and the serialized article has an empty tagList while content/author remain intact.

coverage: Update validator failure after ownership branch
paths.test_intent: As the owner, submit an invalid update payload after the article has been found to prove validation protects persisted state.
paths.expected_internal_effect: FindOneArticle and ownership check succeed, Bind fails, model.Update is not called, and the active article remains unchanged.

paths.test_intent: Use a different authenticated user to attempt update and delete on an existing article.
paths.expected_internal_effect: Both handlers compare AuthorID with the requester's ArticleUserModel.ID, return 403, skip Update/DeleteArticleModel, and the article remains active with original content.

paths.test_intent: Attempt update and delete without a token to verify middleware blocks both before handler logic.
paths.expected_internal_effect: AuthMiddleware(true) aborts each request with 401; ArticleUpdate and ArticleDelete do not run and the article remains active.

paths.test_intent: Delete an existing owned article and verify the deleted state through detail and list reads.
paths.expected_internal_effect: DeleteArticleModel soft-deletes the row by slug; normal FindOneArticle and FindManyArticle paths do not return the deleted article.

paths.test_intent: Cover source-supported behavior for missing slugs: update fails with not-found while delete is idempotent success.
paths.expected_internal_effect: Update stops at FindOneArticle with 404; delete observes missing row, skips ownership check, DeleteArticleModel is a no-op, and returns 200 unless a database error occurs.

raw_metrics.branch_coverage_basis: Practical branch coverage over deterministic auth, validation, ownership, existence, and tag-handling branches. Database error branches in SaveOne, model.Update, DeleteArticleModel, and transaction commit are identified but excluded from the minimal suite because they require fault injection rather than normal lifecycle inputs.

assumptions: The model is source-backed by the golang-gin implementation under Assignment 01/codebases/realworld/implementations/golang-gin; it is not a source-missing logical model.
Post-delete unavailability relies on GORM default scoped queries for models embedding gorm.Model, so soft-deleted rows are excluded from normal FindOneArticle and FindManyArticle queries.
open_questions: The code regenerates the slug directly from title without adding a uniqueness suffix; duplicate-title handling may conflict with the unique slug index and should be checked separately from this lifecycle path model.

The current structured requirements use R1-R12, while the black-box handoff uses an older R1-R16 numbering. Trace links in the report therefore map black-box tests by title/intent as well as by exact IDs where possible.
DELETE on a non-existent slug returns 200 in source code, which is idempotent but not explicitly specified by the structured requirements.
